observations.observation: On March 27, Toshiba announced an MoU to start integration discussions among the identified semiconductor and power-device businesses; it said terms and specific integration details remained undecided.
observations.counterpoint_or_limit: This was a preliminary discussion agreement, not a final integration agreement, and the release stated no timetable.

observations.observation: In July, Bloomberg reported Mitsubishi Electric's CEO aimed to announce a JV plan by September; the same report described unresolved scope differences over whether the combined business should include a broad range of analog chips.
observations.counterpoint_or_limit: The September statement was an aim to announce a JV plan, not confirmation of a binding agreement; scope discussions were already described as difficult.

observations.observation: Jiji Press's September 30 headline and visible lead reported that the three-company talks were running long and behind a summer target; this is the earliest located public report of slippage in this search.
observations.counterpoint_or_limit: The full Jiji article is paywalled, so the exact milestone and reasons for slippage cannot be verified from the accessible text.

observations.observation: DigiTimes published an abstract before cutoff saying the companies missed the original schedule and attributing the slowdown to leadership disputes and increased AI demand.
observations.counterpoint_or_limit: Only the abstract is accessible; the underlying sourcing and fuller account of the stated causes could not be checked.

gaps: The full Jiji Press and DigiTimes articles are paywalled, limiting verification of sourcing, the precise missed milestone, and the detailed causes or state of negotiations.

The public timelines differ in wording and apparent milestone: Jiji refers to a summer target, while the July CEO report refers to announcing a JV plan by September. The March MoU itself set no deadline.
No company-issued confirmation of the slippage or revised timetable was located in the sources verifiably available by cutoff.
research_notes: Cutoff: 2026-10-02T02:03:51.978970Z. The earliest located report of slippage is the Jiji Press item carried by Yahoo Finance Japan on September 30; DigiTimes followed at 01:56Z on October 2, about 7 minutes 52 seconds before cutoff. Public milestones were not identical: the March MoU set no timetable, the Jiji headline refers to a summer target, and Mitsubishi Electric's CEO was reported in July as aiming to announce a JV plan by September. The DigiTimes abstract attributes delay to leadership disputes and surging AI demand, but the full article is paywalled. No post-cutoff coverage or market reaction is used.
